name: ccpii
description: Replaces personal data in prompts and tool results with numbered placeholders (⟦EMAIL_0⟧, ⟦PERSON_1⟧) found by openai/privacy-filter, and restores them in tool calls.

endpoint.title: Detection endpoint
endpoint.description: URL of your own detection service (POST {"texts"} -> {"spans"}, see BACKENDS.md). Empty: run the bundled openai/privacy-filter.

unmaskedKinds.title: Kinds left unmasked
unmaskedKinds.description: Comma-separated placeholder kinds never masked, for example PERSON, URL. Empty: every kind is masked.

unmaskedWords.title: Words left unmasked
unmaskedWords.description: Comma-separated words never masked, in any case, for example your login name. A detected span that holds one of them is left as it is.
